title: Authorize the authority registry relocation
goal: Pre-authorize the exact move, TCB and policy tuples needed to relocate the authority registry into Shared.
acceptanceCriteria: The move authorization binds the complete legacy and Shared directory tuples.
The TCB authorization binds every affected trusted path and component to the frozen candidate.
The weaken-policy authorization binds every registered semantic change and JSON Pointer.
The authorization-only checkpoint changes no implementation, manifest or authority data.
The relocation candidate consumes each authorization exactly once.
